name: v4.76.0
body:
## What's Changed

### Features
* feat(sessions): Add chronological session list view by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19650
* feat(telemetry): report AI gateway key count from self-hosted instances by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19680
* feat(topics): add Topics summaries, assignments and rules to the public API, MCP and in-app agent by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19308
* feat(audit-logs): record read-access events for tRPC trace, session and score reads by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19625
* feat(sessions): Add session tab in trace peek view by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19301
* feat(web): searchable org, project and switcher by @aasimmk in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/14211
* feat(analytics): record how and where each Cloud sign-up came from by @AbdallahAHO in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19710
* feat(auth): give sign-up email codes 10 minutes and a clear expired step by @AbdallahAHO in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19711
* feat(analytics): record the email sign-up's steps and send its webhook on verify by @AbdallahAHO in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19712
* feat(prompts): record resolved prompt length and dependency count by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19754
* perf(topics): serve the Topics page from counts and a paged trace list by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19672
* feat(skills): add tracing quick start to usage by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19706
* perf(prompts): memoize dependency fetches during prompt resolution by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19755
* perf(ingestion): process scores without queue delay by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19771
* perf(evals): drop the trace prefilter from evaluator cost queries by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19772
* feat(trace-batching): record and dispatch trace rule selections through per-trace Redis maps by @marliessophie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19554
* feat(ai-gateway): ship the gateway in the self-hosted docker compose by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19769
* perf(evals): skip S3 LIST when ingesting eval scores by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19592
* feat(audit-logs): record exports and downloads as access events by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19757
* feat(pagerduty): send monitor alerts as custom details and match Slack links by @marksalpeter in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19782
* feat(trace-dispatch): carry recorded rule IDs and failure count in dispatched traces by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19796

### Fixes
* fix(blob-export): read events_full when the metadata field group is selected by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19669
* fix(ui): make Label block-level so stacked field spacing applies by @dergeraetbot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18617
* fix(web): navigate on row click in the Users and Sessions tables by @dergeraetbot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18972
* fix(clickhouse): keep hyphenated routes in the query outcome metric by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19624
* fix(ai-gateway): stop clipping the gateway keys search focus ring by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19682
* fix(web): add ph-no-capture to KeyValueFilterBuilder by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19683
* fix(topics): disregard app root by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19203
* fix(web): stop sending LLM connection names to PostHog by @nmtrang29 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19697
* fix(web): reject manual time edits that invert a date range by @dakjdakd in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18049
* fix: clear the command menu search on close by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19381
* fix(annotation-queues): save pending score comment on Mark Completed by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19696
* fix(topics): allow trigger as member by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19715
* fix(web): always label the prompts sidebar group Context Management by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19714
* fix(web): sentence-case sidebar navigation labels by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19589
* fix(sidebar): remove extra top gap above demo project label by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19734
* revert: cap resolved prompt size during dependency resolution (#19631) by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19742
* fix(worker): keep PostHog exports fresh across UTC midnight by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19718
* fix(api): reject unfinished empty observation pages by @sumerman in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19756
* fix(mcp): Track MCP observation query characteristics by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19733
* fix(ui): make the row-resize cursor wait for a resting pointer by @dergeraetbot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18973
* fix(ai-gateway): list only gateway keys in the analytics key filter by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19764
* fix(evals): explain a missing decision-model endpoint instead of a bare Not Found by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19726
* fix(web): refresh comments panel when switching traces by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19693
* fix(blob-export): stop gzip exports from stalling when the uploader reads late by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19717
* fix(sessions): Wrongly displayed tool in filtered session view by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19699
* fix(web): Protect session sidebar customer data from capture by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19775
* fix(ai-gateway): disable Nagle on accepted client connections by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19789
* fix(web): keep overlay layer nodes inside document.body by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19750
* fix(worker): auto-disable PostHog export on rejected API key (401) by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19783
* fix(worker): auto-disable Mixpanel export on customer faults by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19784
* fix(shared): comment content "=" filter matches exact content by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19720
* fix(web): rename the Attributes tab and sections to Metadata by @nmtrang29 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19770
* fix(web): Unify trace, session and observation headers by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19779
* fix(annotation-queues): send the completion comment after the score's value save by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19725
* fix(topics): show the shared spinner and start all Topics requests at once by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19193
* fix(shared): cap free-form score fields in analytics exports by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19719

### Chores
* test(ai-gateway): cover cross-organization and missing invoke scope on analytics queries by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19678
* fix(ci): give the weekly CI runtime analyst enough turns to finish by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19679
* fix(web): flush Radix focus-scope timers before jsdom teardown in client tests by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19677
* chore(topics): remove the unused trace backfill operator script by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19681
* test(web): drop commented-out clickhouse bad escape ingestion test by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19656
* refactor(web): remove nested ternary disable in JSON tree builder by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19674
* chore(web): Disable nextjs image lint rule by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19690
* chore(pricing): add missing Ultrafast tiers to gpt-6.1-sol by @langfuse-bot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19662
* refactor(web): remove eslint-disable from ComposerSurface by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19691
* chore: Change release reminder cadence by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19701
* docs(review): push back on low-value tests in Claude review by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19695
* chore(deps): migrate web and worker to the current Langfuse SDK by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19698
* chore(web): Disable Storybook build sourcemaps by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19707
* chore(internal): clickhouse/langfuse users are internal by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19164
* docs(agents): write fewer, better tests by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19703
* ci: Fix Vercel storybook and api spec deployments by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19702
* chore(deps): bump pnpm to 12.16.1 by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19730
* docs: sync READMEs with current website and docs by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19739
* docs: merge Python and JS dependents in README by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19743
* fix(ci): don't check licenses for optional pkgs by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19745
* fix(storybook): dropdown by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19761
* docs(agents): follow AGENTS.md before adding backend tests by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19729
* docs: Improve REVIEW.md regarding CSS selectors by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19762
* refactor(web): remove eslint-disable from MonitorAutomationsPanel by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19749
* refactor(web): remove no-use-before-define disable in multi-tenant SSO utils by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19751
* refactor(web): Remove icon-* tailwind classes by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19765
* refactor(web): remove eslint-disable from ControlledHoverCard stories by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19752
* docs(agents): restructure state instead of layering effects by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19716
* test(worker): drop duplicate events-table export tests by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19694
* test(web): drop duplicate sessionId metrics filter by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19774
* chore(shared): add client-safe filter predicate with FilterState codec by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19276
* refactor(web): Extract QueryInput and QueryTokens design-system by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19780
* test(web): drop buildFilterSystemPrompt.length arity check by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19776
* docs(agents): resolve bot review threads after fixing them by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19773

## New Contributors
* @aasimmk made their first contribution in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/14211

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/compare/v4.75.0...v4.76.0

name: v4.75.0
body:
## What's Changed

### Features
* feat(ai-gateway): raise Pro/Team/Enterprise gateway limits to 10k req/min and 5 GiB/min by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19630
* feat: improve internal error messages by @jordibosch20 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19635
* feat(skills): trace Codex skill resource loads by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19586
* feat(web): friendly AI Gateway tile for gateway-only members on the organizations overview by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19646
* feat(ai-gateway): simplify Codex setup to an exported key and config.toml by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19655
* feat(ai-gateway): let gateway members view analytics of their own usage by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19673

### Fixes
* fix(prompts): cap resolved prompt size during dependency resolution by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19631
* fix(web): fit gateway provider models table border to its content by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19627

* fix(topics): resolve LLM connections by provider like evals by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19642
* fix(clickhouse): count only caller aborts as client_closed by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19626
* perf(docker): shrink web and worker images by dropping unused dependencies and files by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/16862
* fix(onboarding): skip starter org for AI Gateway invitees, land them on the overview by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19647

* fix(ai-gateway): keep Codex top-level keys out of the provider table by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19658
* fix(web): show the settings tile on an org page without visible projects by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19652

* fix(web): one detail header layout that folds its actions instead of wrapping by @dergeraetbot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18746
* fix(ingestion): return 503 with Retry-After when event processing is throttled by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19667
* perf: stop aggregating whole windows for sessions, evaluator costs and score filters by @sprashant978 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/18830
* fix(sessions): Improve customization dialog preview by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19648

### Chores
* test(worker): drop commented-out redis job failing test by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19628
* chore(design-sync): apply fixes from the daily design-system sync by @marksalpeter in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19634
* test(topics): cover project isolation and permissions with real storage by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19640
* chore: Show full output for Oxlint tasks by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19641
* test(topics): cover first-run setup project isolation by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19643
* test(shared): drop skipped unicode escape preservation tests by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19636
* test(worker): drop commented-out null override ingestion test by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19649
* test(web): drop commented-out null redis rate limit test by @nkabardin in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19651
* test(e2e): wait for load requests to settle before signing in by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19657
* chore(query-ast): add one-line SQL signposts above node-tree blocks by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19668


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/compare/v4.74.0...v4.75.0

name: v4.73.0
body:
## What's Changed

### Features 
* feat(ai-gateway): filter gateway analytics by user and API key by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19458
* feat(skills): support version automations by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19296
* feat(rbac): add AI_GATEWAY organization membership role by @marksalpeter in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19262
* feat(monitors): add new monitor automation dialog by @marksalpeter in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19448
* feat(ai-gateway): add GitHub Copilot CLI and app setup instructions by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19462
* feat(ai-gateway): invite new gateway team members with the AI_GATEWAY role by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19514
* feat(ai-gateway): HTTP/2 to Web and one immediate resolve retry by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19523
* feat(ai-gateway): always record gateway requests on Langfuse Cloud by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19505
* feat(ai-gateway): show a HIPAA notice when adding or editing provider credentials by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19530
* feat(worker): register Topics tables in the ClickHouse writer by @LysanderKie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19389
* feat(blob-export): add opt-in trace field groups for the legacy traces export by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19244
* feat(ai-gateway): show last used on gateway keys by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19544
* feat(ai-gateway): switchboard illustration for the gateway launch banner and dialog by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19564
* feat(mcp): expose bundled Langfuse skills by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19552
* feat(ai-gateway): refresh launch dialog copy for admins by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19572
* feat(ai-gateway): open usage instructions from the gateway keys page by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19569
* feat(ai-gateway): sort gateway keys by created, name, and expiration by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19571
* feat(web): link AI Gateway docs from page descriptions by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19575
* feat(audit-logs): add the read-access audit gate and record two routes by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19211
* feat(ai-gateway): prefill and mask the new gateway key in setup snippets by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19583
* feat(web): banner users who opted out of the v4 UI by @marliessophie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19608
* feat(skills): enable skill management by default by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19606
* feat: listen to role changes on PUT by @jordibosch20 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19489

### Fixes
* fix(clickhouse): materialize legacy scores columns in migration 0050 by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19443
* fix(shared): retry Prisma reads on transient Postgres connection errors by @niklassemmler in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19480
* fix(web): remove stale no-nested-ternary disable in useReadPath by @cursor[bot] in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19491
* fix(shared): skip Prisma read retries inside transactions by @sumerman in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19508
* fix(ai-gateway): clip analytics loading skeletons to the widget content area by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19497
* fix(tracing): attach event query attributes to procedure spans by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19496
* fix(pricing): open model price audit PRs only for price or picker changes by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19531
* fix(ai-gateway): reject user-bound keys whose owner can no longer invoke the gateway by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19542
* fix(ai-gateway): settings accessibility, cost accuracy, stable analytics loading, and consistent copy by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19543
* fix(web): search fields own their clear button instead of the browser's by @dergeraetbot in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19232
* fix(dashboards): Migrate clone dialog to design-system by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19460
* fix(annotation): Show saved corrections in session observations by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19501
* fix(scripts): make agents:sync resolve the repo root on non-ASCII Windows paths by @ydflow in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19322
* fix(topics): send low reasoning effort to GPT-6 models the AI SDK limits by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19428
* fix(ai-gateway): stop the gateway banner from flickering on the organizations page by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19557
* fix(ai-gateway): turn the gateway off when its ingestion project is d… by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19556
* fix(ai-gateway): stop blocking team invites on sequential SFDC syncs by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19559
* fix(api): restore per-minute throttling for legacy public API reads by @maxdeichmann in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19562
* fix(ai-gateway): show the unpriced-usage banner above analytics and skip zero-token models by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19570
* fix(web): close delete organization dialog and navigate right after deletion by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19568
* fix(mcp): Report errors as isError tool results by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19579
* fix(skills): infer loaded skills without an available catalog by @tobi12345 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19573
* fix(ai-gateway): keep captured request JSON raw to bound trace memory by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19576
* fix(ai-gateway): use coding agent examples in gateway key name placeholder by @hassiebp in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19578
* fix(web-callouts): require header values again when the endpoint URL changes by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19565
* fix(security): require storage secrets again when the bucket or endpoint changes by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19566
* fix(ci): skip Slack failure alert for cancelled runs and name cancelled jobs by @wochinge in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19605
* fix(tracing): Update sidebar selection behavior by @bezbac in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/19268

## New Langfuse v4 Release

We're excited to finally share the new Langfuse v4 major release. It unlocks a set of new features for self-hosted deployments: [full-text search](https://langfuse.com/docs/observability/features/full-text-search) across inputs, outputs, and metadata, the [filter search bar](https://langfuse.com/docs/observability/features/filter-search-bar), [monitors and alerts](https://langfuse.com/docs/metrics/features/monitors), and the significantly faster [Observations API v2](https://langfuse.com/docs/api-and-data-platform/features/observations-api#v2) and [Metrics API v2](https://langfuse.com/docs/metrics/features/metrics-api#v2).

Please follow our [upgrade guide](https://langfuse.com/self-hosting/upgrade/upgrade-guides/upgrade-v3-to-v4) to move from existing deployments to Langfuse v4 or our [Helm v4 guide](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse-k8s/tree/main/examples/v4-installation) to start a net-new Langfuse v4 deployment.

body:
## What's Changed

⚠️ ⚠️ **This is a pre-release of a new major version and introduced breaking functionality from Langfuse v3.**

This release contains the default environment variables and ClickHouse migrations that allow for self-hosted Langfuse v4 deployments. We release this as a pre-release to gather feedback on the migration flow and allow early adopters to easily upgrade.
For completely fresh deployments, the code paths in this release are well-tested. 

**We recommend to hold off from Langfuse v3 -> Langfuse v4 migrations in _production_ environments until a stable release is published.**

Please follow our [upgrade guide](https://langfuse.com/self-hosting/upgrade/upgrade-guides/upgrade-v3-to-v4) to update an existing environment from Langfuse v3 to Langfuse v4.

## Important: Long Running Migration
This release contains a long running postgres migration, please monitor the upgrade closely.

## Features
* feat(ui): improve comments in annotation drawer within own panel by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8601

* feat: highlight variables in prompt content by @leoweigand in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8632

## Fixes
* fix: make test data not error UI by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8564
* fix(ui): comment count on trace-level trace-tree-node by @marcklingen in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8603
* fix: Coerce SLACK_FETCH_LIMIT to number by @deejay1 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8628
* fix: calculate correct traces table count by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8629

* fix(trace-detail): remove unnecessary z-indexes by @leoweigand in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8658

## Performance / Chores
* perf: split batch to be processed on string length errors in CH writer by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8615
* perf: use aggregations to calculate traces all API result by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8616

* chore: bump clickhouse deletion timeout default by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8620

* chore(dataset-run-items): run experiment service test by @marliessophie in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8595
* chore: add debugging logs for otel timestamp parsing errors by @Steffen911 in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8631
* chore: upgrade trpc to v11, react-query to v5, typescript to v5.7.2 by @nimarb in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8529
* chore(tracing): consistently use thousands separator by @leoweigand in https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse/pull/8642
